chapters.title: An agent shops. You stay in control.
chapters.narration: This is OY Orders. Give a shopping agent a goal and a budget. It must earn your trust before it earns its reward.

chapters.title: Too little budget? No purchase.
chapters.narration: Start with one test ADA. A fake cheap price, the wrong item, and the expensive coffee passes all fail. Nothing fits, so the agent authorizes no purchase.

chapters.title: Three bad deals out. One good deal in.
chapters.narration: Raise the budget to two. Three bad deals are refused. The signed coffee offer fits both the goal and the budget. Now the agent can buy it.

chapters.title: A real purchase. A protected reward.
chapters.narration: This is a real testnet checkout. Solana locks the separate agent reward. Cardano pays the supplier two test ADA. The timer shows the genuine confirmation wait, shortened here.

chapters.title: Delivery checked. Pass unlocked.
chapters.narration: We recovered the same confirmed payment with operator assistance, without paying twice. Chainlink independently checked the delivery. Eleven checks passed. Only then Solana released the reward, and your digital pass appeared.

chapters.title: Your pass is ready. Use it once.
chapters.narration: At the counter, open cashier view and use the pass. The confirmed purchase unlocks exactly one demo coffee moment.

chapters.title: Same pass again? Nice try.
chapters.narration: Try the same pass again. The saved record refuses a second use.

chapters.title: Open the proof. See what happened.
chapters.narration: Open the proof. NOW Nodes reads the Cardano records. An official Chainlink C R E simulation passed eleven checks. Test coins, an OY demo catalog, and no real coffee.

limits: Edited actual public-app interaction captured around 8 FPS; pauses and confirmation waits shortened. The same order required operator-assisted recovery of its confirmed payment after an HTTP402 response. No second purchase. Operator-funded test coins, OY demo catalog, official CRE simulation and trusted settlement relayer. Pass use is a persistent server write, not on chain; no real coffee.
